title: StayLog: Time at Places
short: Log when you arrive, leave and how long you stay. One tap or automatic.
full:
How long did you really stay at the office today? How often did you make it to the gym this month?
StayLog records when you arrive at and leave the places you go to often, and how long you stayed — with one tap, or automatically.

■ One tap
• Tap "I'm here" on the round map when you arrive, and "Leave" when you go.
• The first place you tap is saved right away. Just check the name.
• Places you've saved are recognized from your location.

■ Automatic logging
• Turn on automatic logging for a place, and arrivals and departures are recorded even when the app is closed.
• Just passing by? Short visits are ignored. Step out and come back within 10 minutes? It stays one visit.
• If automatic logging stops (location off, battery restrictions), the Home screen shows how to fix it.

■ See your time
• Today and this week, per place
• Monthly calendar: time stayed each day, with dots in each place's color
• Pick one place to see days visited, average per day, and your average first arrival and last departure
• Forgot to tap? Add a missed visit or fix the times in seconds.

■ Add places your way
• Where you are now, address search, or share a place from Google Maps
• Drag the map to set the exact spot and the radius (100–500 m)
• Put the places you use most at the top

■ Without opening the app
• Home screen widgets and a Quick Settings tile
• Undo right from the notification

■ Export
• Save all your visits as a CSV file for timesheets or spreadsheets.

■ Why StayLog uses your location in the background
Only for places where you turn on automatic logging, and only if you allow location "All the time", StayLog uses Android geofencing to notice when you enter or leave those places while the app is closed. Your location is used only to check whether you're at a saved place. StayLog doesn't store your route, and your places and visits stay on your device. Without automatic logging, StayLog works with the button and the "While using the app" permission.

■ Good to know
• No account needed. Your data stays on your phone.
• 20 languages and dark mode.
• StayLog shows ads inside the app.
